description: Unique identifier assigned to each multi-agent research execution log.
Specialized agent role responsible for the logged stage: Researcher, Writer, or Fact_Checker.
Research topic/category handled by the agent during the run. Twenty topics are represented.
Synthetic total token count attributed to the logged agent run.
Synthetic quality score on a 0–1 scale; higher values indicate stronger assessed output quality.
Binary fault indicator: 1 marks a simulated error/anomaly; 0 indicates no recorded simulated error.
